entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To better direct your call, please say 'Sales' or 'Support'.
Connecting you to a support specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help me. I need to return a jersey I bought. I'm just so disappointed.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sarah Miller, order number is VF77819.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the Aero Race Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's just the wrong size for me. I finally got around to trying it on and it's much too tight. I've been a loyal customer for so long... I was thinking about an exchange, but to be honest, I really needed this money back for other things. I feel terrible about it.
I completely understand, it's no problem at all when something doesn't fit quite right. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see the jersey was delivered about 34 days ago.
Oh goodness, has it been that long? I've just been so overwhelmed. I was really hoping it wouldn't be an issue.
Not an issue at all, Sarah. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a huge relief! Thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea how much I appreciate that.

You're very welcome. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. Just pack the item up, attach the label, and you can drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued.
That sounds perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
